title: Oyatie Tenant Model
description: Canonical JSON Schema 2020-12 contract for Oyatie tenant rows. This schema binds ADR-0244 tenant-as-universal-scoping-primitive, ADR-0311 dual-tenant personal/work boundary, and ADR-0313 conglomerate tenant hierarchy into one machine-readable tenant model that downstream Cedar, audit-chain, FinOps, residency, compliance-pack, and ontology-projection surfaces can cite.

_meta.purpose: Canonical machine-readable schema for the Tenant data model per ADR-0242 §D-7. Every workload in the platform is a principal under a tenant; `oyatie` itself is a reserved-namespace tenant. The same tenant primitive carries audience type, jurisdiction, capabilities, compliance packs, audit-stream routing, FinOps cost attribution, KYC status, DR tier, marketplace roles, DSAR contact, and lifecycle locks. This schema is consumed by the tenancy microservice migrations, the reserved-namespace validator, and the Cedar policy engine's tenant-context evaluator.

industry_citations.source: AWS Organizations + IAM principal ARN hierarchy
industry_citations.convention: hierarchical principal paths with reserved partition slug `aws`
hierarchical resource hierarchy with `google` system project

industry_citations.source: Azure AD multi-tenant + First-Party Tenant pattern

industry_citations.convention: first-class tenant primitive across all surfaces

tenant_id.description: Canonical tenant slug. Lowercase ASCII, dot-separated hierarchical sub-scope path. Reserved roots (`oyatie`, `oya`, `oyat`, `oyati`, prefix family `oyatie-*`/`oyatie.*`/`oyatie_*`) refuse registration per ADR-0242 §D-6 reserved-namespace enforcement. Validated via NFKC normalization + diacritic strip + Unicode TR#39 confusables table.
tenant_id.x-reserved-namespace-check: tenancy.reserved_namespace::is_reserved() must return Available before persistence; Cedar fragment policy-engine/fragments/reserved-tenant-namespace.cedar forbids registration of any case-folded/NFKC-normalized/diacritic-stripped equivalent of reserved roots

parent_tenant_id.description: Parent tenant for hierarchical sub-scopes. NULL for root tenants. Sub-scopes inherit jurisdiction, home_cell, capability flags, and Cedar policy from parent unless explicitly overridden. Audit events roll up to parent's audit stream. Cost attribution defaults to deepest sub-scope; FinOps portal rolls up.

audience_type.description: Intent classification for the tenant. Replaces the deprecated per-microservice `audience` manifest field (ADR-0221 §M-04). Audience moves to the tenant primitive; microservices serve all tenants.

x-enum-descriptions.PLATFORM_OWNER: The `oyatie` tenant itself + reserved sub-scopes. Operates as a tenant of its own platform (Amazon/Stripe/Palantir/Apple shape).
x-enum-descriptions.B2B_TENANT: Customer organization (enterprise, SMB, or otherwise). Onboarded via standard onboard saga; may carry sub-tenants for departments/teams.
x-enum-descriptions.B2C_CONSUMER: Individual end-user consumer. Typically onboarded via passkey/OIDC; may federate with B2B parent via SSO.
x-enum-descriptions.DEVELOPER: Third-party developer building plugins/integrations/marketplace listings. KYC/KYB lighter than B2B_TENANT; capabilities gated by plugin-app-store.
x-enum-descriptions.SANDBOX: Per-engineer or per-team development sandbox. Auto-teardown on inactivity (ADR-0242 §D-8). Bounded resources.
x-enum-descriptions.PREVIEW: Per-PR ephemeral preview tenant. Created on PR open, torn down on PR close. Used for reviewer testing of actual PR code.
x-enum-descriptions.PARTNER_AGENCY: Implementation/services agency operating on behalf of one or more customer tenants. Carries assume-role flows to customer tenants per ADR-0244.
x-enum-descriptions.RESELLER: Reseller of the platform to downstream tenants. Bills downstream; oyatie bills reseller. Sub-tenants under reseller follow reseller's permission boundary.
x-enum-descriptions.INTERNAL_AUDITOR_3PAO: ADR-0311 enum extension for third-party assessment organizations and regulator-style auditors. The principal may receive narrowly scoped read permits to audited work-tenant surfaces and never inherits personal-tenant reach.
x-enum-descriptions.B2B_HR_ADMIN: ADR-0311 enum extension for employer HR administrators. The tenant can operate work-tenant lifecycle and offboarding workflows but cannot inspect personal-tenant surfaces.
x-enum-descriptions.B2B_INTERNAL_AUDIT: ADR-0311 enum extension for employer internal-audit principals. The scope is work-tenant evidence and retained work data only; personal-tenant data remains default-deny.
x-enum-descriptions.B2C_JOB_SEEKER_ACTIVE: ADR-0311 enum extension for a personal tenant in active job-seeking posture. This is a B2C_CONSUMER sub-tier that enables portable employment workflows without granting employer access to personal data.

home_cell.description: Canonical cell identifier where the tenant's primary read/write traffic lands. Per ADR-0009 cell-architecture-per-tenant-per-region and ADR-0248 Amazon-shape cellular architecture. Cell identifier format: `<plane>-<role>-<region>-<az>-<shard>`.

dr_cell.description: Disaster-recovery paired cell for failover per ADR-0241 + ADR-0049 cross-region replication. Replication shape determined by `business_continuity_dr_tier`.

jurisdiction.description: Primary regulatory jurisdiction + allowed data-residency regions for this tenant. Cedar overlays per ADR-0240 sovereign-cloud-per-regional-pack key off `primary`. `data_residency_allowed` enumerates ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes where this tenant's data may legally reside; egress to any non-listed code is refused at the inter-cell traffic Cedar gate.

primary.description: Primary jurisdiction code. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 for country-level (e.g., `US`, `KR`, `DE`) or ISO 3166-2 for sub-national (e.g., `US-DE` for Delaware, `US-CA` for California).

data_residency_allowed.description: Enumerated regions where this tenant's data may reside. Inter-cell traffic Cedar gate refuses egress to non-listed regions. Empty array means data must remain only in `primary`.

sovereign_cloud_pack.description: Identifier of a sovereign-cloud regional pack per ADR-0240 that applies overlay rules beyond the default pack matrix. NULL means default pack matrix per cell. Examples include `KR-CSAP-v3.1`, `EU-GAIA-X`, `US-FedRAMP-High`, `SG-MTCS-L3`.

capabilities.description: Boolean capability flags gating payment, settlement, and sub-merchant facilitation. Flips on each capability are gated by KYC/KYB certification per ADR-0251 compliance-pack-cell-certification-levels and Cedar permits. All flags default false at registration; flipped true only after certification.

can_pay.description: Tenant may initiate outbound payments (e.g., card-present, card-not-present, ACH-debit, SEPA-debit). Requires PCI-DSS + per-jurisdiction payment-services certification.

can_receive.description: Tenant may receive inbound payments (e.g., as merchant of record, or as marketplace seller). Requires merchant-status + KYB.

can_settle.description: Tenant may settle funds to bank accounts. Requires KYB + tax registration + per-jurisdiction money-transmitter-license check.

can_facilitate_sub_merchants.description: Tenant may onboard sub-merchants under itself (Stripe platform-facilitator pattern). Requires platform-facilitator certification + sub-merchant onboarding workflow.

x-enum-descriptions.not_a_merchant: No payment capabilities; tenant operates as a pure consumer or non-commercial entity.
x-enum-descriptions.pending_kyb: KYB documents submitted; pending review by ops-compliance.
x-enum-descriptions.merchant_of_record: Standard merchant; sells goods/services and is responsible for tax, chargebacks, etc.
x-enum-descriptions.marketplace_seller: Sells through an oyatie marketplace; oyatie is platform-facilitator.
x-enum-descriptions.platform_facilitator: Operates a platform under which sub-merchants sell. `oyatie` itself is platform_facilitator.
x-enum-descriptions.suspended: Merchant capabilities suspended pending compliance review.

payout_method.description: Settlement instrument identifier. Format: `<method>:<masked-account-fingerprint>`. NULL when settlement not applicable (e.g., `oyatie` itself uses `internal`).

tax_registrations.description: Per-jurisdiction tax registrations carried by this tenant. Drives tax-engine routing decisions (Cedar policy selects which engine — US sales tax, EU VAT, KR 부가세, JP consumption tax, AU GST, etc. — per the registration list).

tax_id.description: Tax identifier in jurisdiction-native format (e.g., US EIN, EU VAT number, KR 사업자등록번호).

dsar_contact.description: DSAR (Data Subject Access Request) intake point per GDPR Article 12 + KR PIPA Article 36 + state-level laws. Applied uniformly per ADR-0242 §D-4 to `oyatie` and all customer tenants — no carve-outs.

legal_owner.description: Internal team or named legal counsel responsible for DSAR response. Free-form but should match a known team/principal slug.

email.description: Contact email for DSAR intake confirmations + clarification.

response_sla_days.description: Maximum days to substantive response (acknowledge + erasure plan + execution). GDPR Article 12 default 30; some jurisdictions shorter.

audit_streams.description: Sealed audit-chain stream identifiers this tenant emits to. Default rollup is the root tenant stream; sub-scopes emit to per-sub-scope sub-streams that roll up to parent. Per ADR-0028 inheritance + per-period Merkle sealing cadence.

finops_cost_center.description: Identifier for the cost center to which this tenant's per-action spend (LLM tokens, compute-hours, storage, network egress, third-party API fees) attributes by default. Per ADR-0174 FinOps tags + sub-scope rollup default.

marketplace_roles.description: Marketplace participation roles. A single tenant may carry multiple roles simultaneously (e.g., a tenant that both sells and resells).

seller_categories.description: Selling categories the tenant has been certified for. Drives compliance-pack eligibility (e.g., HEALTH category requires HIPAA-2024 pack on US-resident customer data).

fulfillment_capabilities.description: Fulfillment modes the tenant can serve. Drives shipping/logistics workflow routing.

trust_score.description: Composite trust score in [0, 1]. Input to risk-evaluation Cedar fragments (high-risk actions gated by minimum trust_score thresholds). Computed from KYC/KYB, chargeback history, dispute rate, account age, and behavioral signals.

x-enum-descriptions.not_required: Tenant audience type does not require KYC (e.g., SANDBOX, PREVIEW).
x-enum-descriptions.pending_documents: Tenant has not yet submitted KYC/KYB documents.
x-enum-descriptions.in_review: Documents submitted; ops-compliance review in progress.
x-enum-descriptions.verified: Standard KYC verified; suitable for most B2B and B2C consumer flows.
x-enum-descriptions.verified_enhanced: Enhanced due diligence (e.g., PEP screening, sanctions check, source-of-funds review). Required for high-risk categories.
x-enum-descriptions.expired: KYC verification has expired; re-verification required.

compliance_packs.description: Active compliance pack identifiers per ADR-0251. Each pack ships a bundle of Cedar fragments + retention rules + audit chain requirements + DPIA template references. Activation gated by `eligible_capabilities` + KYB.

provider_credential_mode.description: Per ADR-0255 §D-4. LLM/provider API credential resolution mode (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Cohere, Bedrock, self-hosted vLLM, etc.). `platform_default` uses oyatie-owned provider credentials (default for B2C personal-use surfaces). `byok` opts in to tenant-owned provider credentials/subscriptions. `byok_required_by_pack` is set automatically when at least one active compliance pack carries `provider_byok_required: true` (HIPAA / PCI / FedRAMP / IL5-6 / KR-FSS / EU-AI-Act high-risk); the tenant cannot select `platform_default` while such a pack is active. Disjoint from encryption-key BYOK, which is tracked under the encryption substrate (ADR-0251 §D-10).

policy_evaluation_mode.description: ADR-0244 Wave-3-A amendment field selecting how tenant-scoped Cedar decisions dispatch. `library_first` uses the in-process audited library path by default. `network_only` forces policy-engine network evaluation. `library_first_with_attested_fallback` permits cached/library decisions only until `attested_fallback_threshold`, then requires attested network fallback under the meta-trust-root witness path.

attested_fallback_threshold.description: ISO 8601 duration equivalent of the ADR-0244 `attested_fallback_threshold` interval. Applies when `policy_evaluation_mode` is `library_first_with_attested_fallback`; cached/library decisions older than this duration require attested policy-engine fallback.

ontology_read_mode.description: ADR-0244 / ADR-0257 amendment field selecting how ontology reads resolve for this tenant. `library_first` uses the local substrate path; `network_only` forces ontology service reads; `library_first_with_freshness_floor` uses local reads until data age exceeds `freshness_floor`.

freshness_floor.description: ISO 8601 duration equivalent of ADR-0244 `freshness_floor`. Applies when `ontology_read_mode` is `library_first_with_freshness_floor`; ontology projection data older than this duration must refresh through the network path before serving regulated or tenant-visible reads.

controls_tenants.description: ADR-0313 denormalized index of child tenant ids this tenant controls through source-of-truth conglomerate_grants. This is a read-optimized mirror only; the grant table remains canonical and Cedar decides parent-scope actions.

controlled_by_tenants.description: ADR-0313 denormalized reverse index of parent tenant ids that control this tenant through source-of-truth conglomerate_grants. The field exists for lookup speed; parent authority, residency preservation, information barriers, and personal-tenant refusal remain Cedar-governed.

is_personal_tenant.description: ADR-0311 shortcut classifier. True only when the tenant is a personal-tenant surface (`audience_type` is `B2C_CONSUMER` or `B2C_JOB_SEEKER_ACTIVE`). Work-tenant principals cannot read personal-tenant resources absent self-access or ADR-0312 warrant-scoped piercing.

eligible_capabilities.description: Capability identifiers the tenant is eligible to activate (post-KYB/KYC + post-pack-adoption). A tenant may be eligible without having activated the capability.

locked.description: Lifecycle lock. When true, the tenant row cannot be modified or deleted without ops-compliance approval via the unlock saga. `oyatie` root tenant is locked at bootstrap.

created_at.description: Tenant creation timestamp (ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 with timezone).

created_by.description: Principal identifier that created this tenant. For bootstrap-created tenants, `system:bootstrap-migration`.

updated_by.description: Principal identifier that performed the most-recent update.

dsar_status.description: Current DSAR cascade state for this tenant (most-recent or open request).

open_request_id.description: UUID of any open DSAR cascade; NULL if none open.

last_completed_at.description: Timestamp of most-recent completed DSAR response.

open_holds.description: Legal/regulatory holds that supersede erasure for some data classes.

business_continuity_dr_tier.description: DR tier per ADR-0241 portfolio policy. Tenant-level default; per-microservice declarations may override for specific services this tenant uses.

x-enum-descriptions.T1: Active-active multi-AZ cross-region warm. RTO < 5min; RPO 0s. Quarterly + ad-hoc drills.
x-enum-descriptions.T2: Active-passive cross-region continuous replication. RTO < 60min; RPO < 60s. Quarterly drills.
x-enum-descriptions.T3: Backup/restore cross-region warm. RTO < 240min; RPO < 900s. Semi-annual drills.
x-enum-descriptions.T4: Backup/restore cold. RTO < 1440min; RPO < 3600s. Semi-annual tabletop drills.

tenantId.description: Shared tenant identifier used by tenant rows, parent/child denormalized indexes, audit streams, Cedar contexts, and ontology projections. Lowercase ASCII with up to six dotted path segments.

principalRef.description: Shared principal reference for created_by, updated_by, legal owners, Cedar signer references, and tenant-local actor ids.

cellId.description: Shared cell identifier for home and DR routing decisions.

jurisdictionCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, ISO 3166-2, or portfolio-level region shorthand used by residency and compliance pack decisions.

compliancePackId.description: Compliance pack identifier per ADR-0251 and /specs/compliance-pack-schema.json.

auditStreamId.description: Audit-chain stream identifier for baseline, sub-scope, pack-specific, and dual-sealed tenant emissions.

capabilityId.description: Tenant-eligible capability id used before capability-tier grant activation.

isoDuration.description: ISO 8601 duration string used for thresholds, retention floors, and freshness floors.

legalHold.description: Shared legal-hold object used by DSAR state and compliance-pack retention overlays.

allOf.description: PLATFORM_OWNER audience implies reserved-namespace tenant_id (must start with `oyatie`).
SANDBOX and PREVIEW audience types must declare auto-teardown via parent oyatie.dev.* or oyatie.preview.* path.
If can_settle is true, tenant must have at least one tax registration and merchant_status of merchant_of_record, marketplace_seller, or platform_facilitator.
If can_facilitate_sub_merchants is true, merchant_status must be platform_facilitator.
B2B_TENANT and DEVELOPER audience types require KYC verification before any payment capability flips true.

match_rules: IDN-homograph variants per UTR #36 confusables table
